svg.title: The handshake bill, with ML-DSA-44 everywhere
svg.desc: Authentication bytes in the TLS handshake (Certificate message plus CertificateVerify): classic X.509 with two SCTs and an intermediate 15,271; the same with the intermediate left out 11,353; MTC standalone with the CA and two witnesses 11,417; with the CA and one witness 8,990; landmark-relative 4,296.

text.tspan: standalone MTC drops the intermediate, but keeps three signatures. The landmark drops them too.
